description: This file contains the implementation of the SyncEngine class responsible for synchronizing notes between local storage and a remote API, including observing network connectivity, handling push and pull operations, and managing note states.

classes.name: SyncEngine
classes.description: A final class responsible for synchronizing notes between local and remote sources, managing connectivity monitoring, and coordinating push and pull operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts observing network connectivity and triggers synchronization when online.

methods.name: syncOnce
methods.description: Performs a single synchronization cycle: pushes local changes to remote and pulls remote changes to local storage, handling errors and updating note states accordingly.
